name: @tenure/platform-config
description: What the platform makes configurable: the definitions, the registry, and resolution for one institution.
//exports: Two entry points on purpose. The main one reaches @tenure/configuration, whose resolver imports node:crypto for checksums — importing it from a module that client components also import fails the build with UnhandledSchemeError. `./money` is the client-safe subset: a pure Intl formatter with no imports at all.
